description: nibabel-skill 统筹已登记的独立方法和可复用流程。支持：Nibabel NIfTI 实际检查；图谱坐标提取；NIfTI 头信息与空间检查；FreeSurfer 表面与分区读取；NiBabel NIfTI 保存／格式转换。

method_refs.label: Nibabel NIfTI 实际检查
method_refs.default_reason: 轻量检查不会修改输入影像，适合在处理前确认文件空间信息。
method_refs.role: 读取 NIfTI 头、维度、数据类型、体素尺寸与仿射矩阵，并可保存规范化副本。

method_refs.label: 图谱坐标提取
method_refs.role: Reference script for atlas ROI center extraction with nibabel。 Inputs: atlas: 分区图谱 (file); labels: 图谱标签文本 (file). Registered outputs: results/coordinates.csv.

method_refs.label: NIfTI 头信息与空间检查
method_refs.role: Read image dimensions, voxel sizes, affine matrix, axis orientation and stored data type with NiBabel and write inspection.json; no image resampling is performed。 Inputs: image: NIfTI (file). Registered outputs: results/inspection.json. Fixed invocation options: --operation inspect.

method_refs.label: FreeSurfer 表面与分区读取
method_refs.role: Read FreeSurfer surface vertices/faces and annotation labels/colours with NiBabel; verify matching vertex counts and export the arrays in surface.npz。 Inputs: surf: 表面 (file); annot: 标注 (file). Registered outputs: results/surface.npz. Fixed invocation options: --operation surface.

method_refs.label: NiBabel NIfTI 保存／格式转换
method_refs.role: Load an existing image with NiBabel and save it as image.nii.gz, retaining its voxel data and geometry. This is format conversion, not registration。 Inputs: image: 已有影像 (file). Registered outputs: results/image.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation save.

selection_rules: 先确认目标产物、允许使用的已有输入与禁止复用的结果；仅在用户允许时复用已有数据，不默认追加上游步骤。
独立操作选择 Method；确需固定组合时选择 Pipeline，并检查每一步输入输出。
软件工具 Skill 用于选择实现，任务 Skill 用于组织需求，不因为同时匹配两类 Skill 重复添加方法。

Treat missing inputs according to the current goal: for explicitly requested steps, ask for binding or discuss alternatives; when asked to produce a target from stated inputs, add only necessary available producers allowed by the user. Never regenerate an explicitly reused result or silently broaden the scientific goal.

Select by scientific output meaning, stage conditions and spatial/data requirements. A directory, generic image or report does not certify a typed derivative. Do not equate tissue classes, anatomical atlas regions and learned clusters. Query the Method contract for exact ports and conditional parameters; use Pipelines only when their actual steps match the request.
name: nibabel-skill
applicability: 根据目标选择对应 Method 或 Pipeline；每个入口的输入格式、必要参数和产物以其独立契约为准。
limitations: 格式和样本数量满足仅是必要条件；空间、单位、样本标识与方法假设仍须按所选方法检查。
这里只统筹已登记入口；目录收录不代表覆盖软件全部命令或参数。
环境探测与运行证据分别显示；合成数据测试不代表真实数据的科学有效性。
尚无 Method 的规划能力只能提供说明，不能当作可执行步骤。

examples.request: 查看 Nibabel NIfTI 实际检查 所需的输入和参数
examples.decision: 查询 nibabel.inspect 的契约，绑定文件后再规划执行。
